draft_body: At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier was not ready despite its four-bar gauge.

chapters.chapter_body: The North Glass door opens only for a wearer of a blue badge; a red badge cannot open it.
chapters.span_body: The North Glass door opens only for a wearer of a blue badge; a red badge cannot open it.

chapters.chapter_body: At 10点 on the same day, Mira tried the North Glass door while wearing only a red badge and carrying no blue badge; the roster does not record whether it opened.
chapters.span_body: At 10点 on the same day, Mira tried the North Glass door while wearing only a red badge and carrying no blue badge; the roster does not record whether it opened.

chapters.chapter_body: The spare blue badge register leaves its 11点 holder field blank.
chapters.span_body: The spare blue badge register leaves its 11点 holder field blank.

chapters.chapter_body: A North Glass pneumatic carrier is ready for dispatch only when its pressure gauge reads four bars and its valve cap is locked.
chapters.span_body: A North Glass pneumatic carrier is ready for dispatch only when its pressure gauge reads four bars and its valve cap is locked.

chapters.chapter_body: At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier gauge read four bars, but its valve cap remained loose and not locked throughout that minute.
chapters.span_body: At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier gauge read four bars, but its valve cap remained loose and not locked throughout that minute.

chapters.chapter_body: The carrier inspection does not record who loosened its valve cap.
